TEJAX KART / PLAYER HANDBOOK

Your phone.
Your wheel.

Install TEJAX KART from your mobile browser, then steer by tilting your phone. The game supports Android and iPhone browsers with WebGL. Motion controls require supported sensors, permission and a secure connection.

How do I download the mobile game?

TEJAX KART installs as a web app from this website. There is no APK, IPA or app-store download.

  1. Android: open this website in Chrome. Tap Install mobile game below, or open the browser menu and choose Install app / Add to Home screen.
  2. iPhone / iPad: open the website in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Confirm Add. Menu wording can vary with browser and OS version.
  3. Launch TEJAX KART from the new home-screen icon while online. Wait for the offline-ready status before disconnecting.

Saving the game for offline solo play…

How do I enable tilt steering?

  1. Open the game’s garage, then Settings.
  2. In Mobile tilt steering, tap Enable tilt. Allow motion access if your browser requests it.
  3. Hold the phone at a comfortable driving angle. Tap Calibrate.
  4. Tilt left to steer left and right to steer right. Choose auto-acceleration, or use the GAS pedal. BRAKE overrides auto-acceleration.
  5. Save settings and start a race. CENTER TILT recalibrates during play. Pause → Tilt steering settings opens the controls again.

Portrait and landscape are supported. After rotating the phone, hold it steady to reset the neutral angle. Lower the sensitivity angle for a stronger response to small movements. Enable Invert tilt if your preferred grip needs reversed input. Tilt permission is requested by your tap; it is never requested automatically.

Tilt troubleshooting

My phone does not steer. What should I check?

Use the public HTTPS website, enable motion permission in browser settings, and tap Enable tilt again. Some devices or embedded browsers do not expose sensors. Try Safari on iPhone or Chrome on Android. If there are no readings, the game falls back to touch steering.

How do I fix drifting while holding the phone still?

Tap CENTER TILT while holding your normal driving position. A small dead zone filters hand movement. Increase the sensitivity angle to reduce steering response, or turn tilt off and use the joystick.

Can I play without internet?

Yes, solo modes work after every game asset has been saved and the page says Offline ready. Browser storage can be removed by the device; reconnect if assets are missing. LAN multiplayer needs a connection to its server.

Why is there no install button in my browser?

Installation menus vary. Use Safari’s Add to Home Screen on iPhone, or Chrome’s menu on Android. If your browser does not offer installation, you can still play online in the browser.

Can I play without tilt?

Yes. Drag the left joystick to steer and accelerate, or use the GAS and BRAKE pedals. The right-side buttons control drift, boost and weapons. Landscape gives the controls more space.

Motion readings stay on your device. See privacy and storage.
